objectives: Nanotechnology is a cross-disciplinary subject. Recently, it has developed from physics, chemistry, materials and electronics in the scientific field to biomedicine. The key factor is the advancement of material development and device design progress. This course will focus on the fundamentals and applications of nanotechnology, including intrinsic property of nanomaterial, manufacturing processes, analysis, and promising application for future sensor technology.
content:
第1週　奈米科技導論
第2–4週　奈米材料特性（一、二、三）
第5–7週　微/奈米製程（一、二、三）
第8週　期中考
第9–12週　微/奈米材料分析（一、二、三、四）
第13–14週　感測器設計（一、二）
第15週　文獻討論與案例分享
第16週　期末報告
